segments: [0.00-2.04]  Let me show you the prototype of our solution.
[2.38-4.78]  Here's our web app, phone app, and a terminal coding
[4.78-6.94]  assistant, which also runs inside an editor.
[7.50-10.46]  Administrators manage knowledge and access
[10.46-11.54]  through this separate panel.
[12.00-13.68]  These are different views of the same platform.
[16.74-18.20]  Starting in the admin panel, files
[18.20-20.50]  are organized into collections and assigned a sensitivity
[21.60-23.96]  Progam reads their contents, including scanned pages
[23.96-25.94]  and makes them searchable with page references.
[26.46-29.32]  Here, an older procedure is marked as superseded
[29.32-30.94]  and linked to the current revision.
[34.05-36.49]  The knowledge graph connects equipment, reports,
[36.75-37.13]  and procedures.
[37.71-40.85]  Here, I select a valve and explore its related documents.
[41.41-44.59]  These connections also support the assistant's tool.
[45.29-47.19]  This is company knowledge, not personal memory.
[50.40-52.18]  Here's how those permissions are managed.
[52.62-54.96]  Employees need both permissions for the collection
[54.96-57.24]  and clearance for the document's sensitivity.
[57.92-61.00]  Access can be assigned to a account, group, or role.
[61.46-63.48]  Viewers read, editors add documents,
[63.74-64.94]  and owners manage grants.
[65.32-67.74]  Here, the engineer can retrieve the report
[67.74-70.38]  while the IT employee cannot retrieve it
[70.38-71.32]  with the same question.
[74.32-76.08]  When a collection is discoverable,
[76.44-79.44]  but log an employee can ask Progam to request access
[79.44-81.16]  with a reason and a duration.
[81.66-83.38]  The administrator reviews that request
[83.38-84.88]  and can approve or reject it.
[85.12-87.68]  Approval creates time-limited read access.
[88.20-91.60]  When the grant expires, that access ends.
[92.14-94.08]  It does not raise the employee's clearance.
[94.48-96.50]  Hidden collections are not exposed
[96.50-97.86]  through this discovery flow.
[100.66-103.48]  Progam uses the catalog through permission check tools,
[103.88-105.38]  searching documents, reading pages,
[105.72-106.94]  and following equipment links.
[107.34-109.22]  It acts under the employee's identity,
[109.36-111.26]  not with the unlimited database access.
[111.82-114.06]  Return, excerpts, and the source references
[114.06-116.08]  help the assistant build its answer.
[116.52-117.68]  The employee can also choose
[117.68-119.56]  how much reasoning effort to be used.
[122.69-124.29]  Let's try an inspection task
[124.29-126.37]  using our synthetic refinery documents.
[126.71-128.79]  I asked why this valve failed.
[129.11-130.67]  Progam retrieves the scan report,
[130.99-132.25]  checks the current procedure,
[132.81-135.67]  and explains the failed checks with page references.
[136.19-138.01]  I then asked for a replacement note.
[138.37-140.45]  It creates a draft covering the problem,
[140.71-143.33]  evidence, required action, and approval request.
[143.81-145.79]  The employee can review both the sources
[145.79-147.41]  and the draft before acting.
[150.60-152.28]  Developers use the same platform
[152.28-154.42]  through their terminal or inside the editor.
[155.10-156.80]  After signing in, the coding agent
[156.80-158.72]  can query the company catalog
[158.72-160.28]  using developer's permissions.
[160.96-163.82]  For example, it can retrieve the current valve testing rule
[163.82-165.50]  before writing a pressure check function.
[166.04-168.28]  It can inspect files, propose changes,
[168.74-170.52]  and run commands on developer's machine,
[170.86-171.98]  subject to its permissions.
[178.50-179.66]  Personal memories separate
[179.66-181.12]  from company knowledge catalog.
[181.58-183.62]  It stores useful facts about me,
[183.90-186.72]  my reporting preferences, and relevant past contexts,
[187.02-188.60]  not the company's document catalog.
[188.96-190.92]  I can ask Progam to remember a format,
[190.92-192.86]  start a new chart, and use it again.
[193.32-196.58]  The web and phone charts recall the relevant saved facts.
[196.94-200.00]  I can inspect, edit, or delete them, or turn memory off.
